fact: The Portfolio Committee on Home Affairs, adopting its Budget Vote Report, required the department under recommendation 6.8 to report on how it would mitigate reductions in transversal IT management funding, which the Committee found posed significant risks to its digitisation initiatives, automated birth registration among them; the department listed automated birth registration among its current priorities.
title: Home Affairs Budget Vote Report; DHA rollout plan for self-service kiosks; MRC Interim Report on GPW; with Deputy Minister
